The contract sets anchorDay only on a date 'clamped by a monthly rule without monthly or by a yearly rule', and Feb 28 to Feb 28 is not clamped. The app itself promises Feb 28 three times: the kinds list says 'Yearly Feb 28', the row marker says 'Repeats: Every year on February 28', and so does the card chip. ACTUAL: right after Yearly is chosen, the Repeats section already reads 'Next: Tue, Feb 29, 2028'. The row marker still says 'Every year on February 28'. From here the yearly series means 'last day of February'. Cause: store.setRepeat resets anchorDay only when repeat is turned on, not when the rule changes, and recur.js intendedDay applies it to yearly rules.
